in_sanskrit.name: Bibha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wisdom and Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bibha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bibha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vidhya’ which means knowledge and wisdom. Bibha is the name of the Goddess of wisdom and knowledge, who is revered in Hindu mythology. She is the embodiment of knowledge, intelligence, and learning. In Hinduism, the Goddess Bibha is often depicted as having multiple arms, each holding a symbol of knowledge and wisdom.
